wiki.title: Brent Taylor (Tennessee politician)
wiki.extract: Brent Louis Taylor (born August 9, 1968) is an American politician who has served since 2023 as a member of the Tennessee Senate representing District 31. A member of the Republican Party, he was first elected to the Tennessee Senate in 2022. Taylor succeeded Brian Kelsey who pled guilty to campaign finance charges and did not seek re-election. He is a candidate in the 2026 election for Tennessee's 9th congressional district.
